description:
Return the WATR standard that applies to a snippet, so that YOU judge it.

This server does not judge code: it hands back the structural signals it
observes, the applicable rules with their stance, the meta-heuristics that
govern the call, and the mandatory output format. The reasoning and the
verdict are yours; the corpus supplies the consistency.

Nothing leaves this server. Prefer this over judge_code when the code
cannot go to a third party.

— Devuelve el estándar WATR que aplica a un fragmento, para que TÚ emitas
el veredicto. Este servidor no juzga el código: entrega las señales
estructurales, las reglas aplicables con su stance y el formato de salida
obligatorio. No sale nada de este servidor.
name: review_code
